title: Salary calculator
description: Calculate salary for inclusive dates using the monthly reference salary, office weekends, and attendance overtime.
scope: Range base pay + payable overtime earnings only. Existing signed overtime adjustments are preserved. No extra deductions, allowances, or payment records are created.
ongoing: This is an ongoing month. Base pay covers the selected dates; overtime includes attendance recorded so far. This is not finalized payroll.
invalidRange: Choose both dates within the selected payroll month, with the from date on or before the to date.
rangePolicy: Both start and end dates are included. Range base pay = monthly reference salary ÷ 26 × calendar days excluding the employee office’s configured weekends. Only weekends are excluded; attendance overtime is added separately.
rangeDraft: Apply the changed dates before calculating.
invalidPeriod: Choose a valid payroll month and year.
tableNote: Rates use the latest salary revision effective on or before the selected month.
dailyRateNote: The daily rate is rounded for display. Base pay uses the unrounded monthly reference salary ÷ 26 result.
calculateVisible: Calculate configured employees on this page
effectiveHint: This revision applies from the chosen month until another revision takes effect. Changes to an existing month create an audited revision.
saved: Salary settings saved. Recalculate to use the latest rates.
calculated: Salary calculations are ready. Statements use these exact previews.
moneyInvalid: Enter a non-negative amount with up to 16 integer digits and two decimal places. Zero is allowed.
missingSettings: Configure both salary amounts before calculating or downloading a statement.
downloadFailed: The statement could not be downloaded. Refresh or recalculate, then try again.
stale: Salary settings, attendance, or the office weekend policy changed, or this preview expired. Recalculate before downloading the statement.
calculationFailed: The calculation failed. Refresh and try again.
saveFailed: Salary settings could not be saved. Refresh to verify the current revision before trying again.
attendanceSource: Payable overtime comes from the authoritative attendance report, including existing approval and late-arrival effects. It is read-only here.
emptyDescription: Adjust the employee search or office and department filters.
unavailable: This salary workspace is no longer available. Sign in again to continue.
settingsChanged: Salary settings changed. Recalculate this employee before downloading.
